representation_fit.evidence: Brief shape entity-hierarchy (many, high hierarchy, high density, batch ops, explicit status ownership). Initial screen (both viewports) shows a 3-level org tree (华东大区›上海›静安门店, data.js:13-31), 59-device dense table with per-device id/type/model/owner/tags (screenshots 1280x860 & 1440x900), group-level batch selection with 仅直属/含子孙 scope toggle (index.html:29-34), and explicit status provenance 自身状态 vs 生效状态·归属 (app.js:74-83, 274-276). Exact match to object_type=entity.

primary_task_salience.evidence: Center ~55% of both screenshots is the entity table; right panel is a permanently visible 批量操作区 with the four batch ops 修改状态/移动分组/添加标签/删除设备 (index.html:57-70); left tree is a group-selection instrument. Batch management is the dominant surface at first paint; screenshot shows ops disabled at 0-selected with an instructive empty state (app.js:317-319).

time_to_understand.evidence: Model-judged proxy. Title 设备资产批量管理台 (index.html:6), labeled panels 组织层级/批量操作区, global status counters 设备59/运行中33/维护中13/已停用12/已报废1/受保护3 (screenshot 1280x860, matching data.js:47-57 sums), plus in-place hints explaining scope semantics and the confirm-sheet flow (index.html:34, 69). What/where is immediate; minor caveat: rightmost table columns clipped at 1280 (see frontend_rework).

navigation_cost.evidence: All 59 entities are on the initial screen with no drill-in required; group subtree view is 1 click on tree name with breadcrumb path + counts (app.js:197-203, 230-249); batch reach is 2 clicks (group checkbox → op button) then confirm modal; search/status-filter/仅看已选 are inline (index.html:41-52). No page changes anywhere in source (single index.html, app.js render() only).

context_loss.evidence: All actions preserve state in place: confirm sheet is an overlay listing per-device deltas (app.js:514-570), log is a non-navigating drawer (app.js:775-808), selection survives filter changes (state.selection Set, app.js:48-64), Escape closes topmost layer only (app.js:969-975), result card + undo returned into the same panel (app.js:340-346). No routes/history use in source.

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Surfaces map 1:1 to the brief's job (tree=selection, table=dense entities, ops panel=batch), so little is gratuitous; but the table mandates 8 columns at min-width:880px (styles.css:177, colgroup app.js:286-288) inside a center panel of ~634px at 1280 and ~804px at 1440 — a permanent surface carrying more than the viewport can present, evidenced by layout.overflow=fail and clipped 保护 column in both screenshots. Many always-on micro-controls (policy dot per tree node app.js:205-211, lock button per row app.js:277-279) are functional yet add density.

accessibility.evidence: Receipt: a11y.contrast=fail, a11y.focus_order=fail, a11y.target_size=fail (measurement-summary.json). Source corroborates: 10-10.5px gray #8a93a6 text (.sub styles.css:193, .src styles.css:220, .gcount styles.css:148, contrast ≈3:1); 16px tree expander (styles.css:134-137) and ~14px policy dot (styles.css:142); modals/menu/drawer are innerHTML-rendered with no focus move, trap, or ARIA roles (app.js:502-512, 744-763, 805-807); tree checkboxes labeled only via title (app.js:189). Affordances are visible but fail measurable a11y on three of three checks.

frontend_rework.evidence: Six of seven receipt checks failed (measurement-summary.json: pass=1 fail=6, target_invalid=false): layout.overflow=fail and layout.responsive_collision=fail are visible — at 1280x860 the 生效状态·归属 and 保护 columns are cut after 自身状态; at 1440x900 保护 is still clipped (table min-width 880px vs narrower panel, styles.css:177). Visible clipping at BOTH measured viewports plus type/target/contrast/focus failures imply non-trivial defect rework. text.truncation=pass is the sole pass.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed 批量选择与操作零误伤，状态归属显式: (1) zero-collateral — per-device confirm sheet with per-row include/exclude and protected devices skip-by-default with explicit override checkbox (app.js:461-628; 受保护3 counter on screenshot; data.js:48,52,55 locked flags), skip count reported in result/toast (app.js:423-431); (2) explicit status ownership — own-status vs 继承·分组名 vs 系统默认 provenance per row (app.js:74-83, 275-276), group policy editor with before/after impact preview listing exactly which devices change (app.js:638-703), effective-status filter incl. 仅看：自身覆盖 (index.html:49).

defects_observed: Table horizontal overflow at both viewports: min-width:880px table in a narrower center panel — 生效状态·归属/保护 columns clipped at 1280x860, 保护 clipped at 1440x900 (checks layout.overflow, layout.responsive_collision = fail)
a11y.contrast fail: low-contrast 10-10.5px #8a93a6 secondary text throughout (styles.css:57,115,148,193,220)
a11y.focus_order fail: dynamically rendered modal/status-menu/drawer receive no focus management and expose no ARIA roles (app.js:502-512,744-763,805-807)
a11y.target_size fail: 16px tree expander (styles.css:134-137) and ~14px policy dots (styles.css:142) below target-size threshold
type.min_projected_size fail: multiple 10-10.5px font sizes for substantive content (styles.css:57,148,193,220,346)
Status-attribution cell 继承·浦东门店·门店改造中 wraps to two lines at 1440 (screenshot 1440x900, .src max-width:150px styles.css:220) — cosmetic
scores.overall_note: The package is a coherent, brief-faithful implementation of manage×entity-hierarchy: a single static page whose initial screen already carries all 59 seeded entities (counts in screenshots reconcile exactly with data.js:47-57), a hierarchy tree doubling as a batch-selection instrument with explicit 仅直属/含子孙 scoping, a confirm-sheet mechanism enforcing per-device review with protected devices skipped by default, and fully explicit status provenance (own override vs nearest group policy vs system default) backed by a policy editor with change previews and an undoable transaction log — directly covering the acceptance seed on both its halves. The measured weaknesses are concentrated in presentation quality, not structure: the receipt shows 6/7 checks failing (target_invalid=false, so the run is valid), and the screenshots confirm the concrete one — an 880px-min table clipped at both 1280x860 and 1440x900 — alongside sub-threshold type sizes, small targets, low-contrast grays, and absent focus management in overlays. Source also contains hash-based scenario deep links (#s=2…7, app.js:834-877) that replay operational states through the same internal functions; they were not active in either captured screenshot (log count 0, empty selection), so all scores above rest on the initial screen and static source only. Task completion time, retrieval accuracy, and human preference remain unmeasured in this pilot; these scores are model-judged from artifacts, not human ratings.
